sacredAudio.earthMultipleBullet: 432 Hz = 8 Hz x 54: Exact multiple of Earth's heartbeat.
sacredAudio.scienceTitle2: Resonance with Body Water & the Moon
sacredAudio.scienceText2: The human body is made of over 70% water. Just as the Moon exerts gravitational pull on ocean tides, 432 Hz structures cellular water into perfect geometry. During Dhikr, Tasbih, and meditation, this vibration calms the heart rate, reduces cortisol, and induces deep tranquility (Sakinah).

seven-kings.wafqDescDetail: The central numerical square of dimension {size}x{size} balances the frequencies of planet {planet} to concentrate blessings (Barakah).
seven-kings.dualKingsDescDetail: The association of the Celestial King ({angel}) and Earthly King ({king}) ensures the fulfillment of the ritual.
seven-kings.protocolSubtitle: Traditional guidelines for serene contemplation and use of the seal
seven-kings.p1Desc: Perform ritual ablutions, dress in clean clothes, and choose a quiet place free from distractions.
seven-kings.p2DescDetail: Ideally practice on the seal's day (ex: {day} at sunrise) to benefit from the alignment of planet {planet}.
seven-kings.p3DescDetail: Burn a pinch of natural incense ({incense}) to elevate the vibrational atmosphere of the space.
seven-kings.p4Desc: Recite Ayat Al-Kursi 7 times along with Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas before any meditation or seal drawing.
seven-kings.cardinalArchangels: The 4 Cardinal Archangels of the Circle
seven-kings.protectionText: Recite Ayat Al-Kursi 7x, along with Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas.
